assumptions.status: Hypothetical assumptions; not measured iris parameters
notes: Null half-life means no corresponding loss pathway in the observation horizon.
Baseline synthesis balances baseline loss in the mobile pool.
During modulation, synthesis is f times its original rate and loss is k0 plus a.
The added loss rate does not silently increase baseline synthesis.
The persistent pool has no influx or efflux during this modeled horizon.
After withdrawal, added loss stops and synthesis resumes at the declared recovery factor times its original rate.
Fivefold recovery synthesis is a hypothetical control comparison, not a drug, dose, or demonstrated response.
Pigment inventory targets are bookkeeping benchmarks, not desired colors.
